name: SendMouseClickNode
label: Send Mouse Click
description: Sends a mouse click event to the specified location.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: MouseEvent
fields.label: Mouse Event to Send
fields.description: The type of mouse event to send (e.g., Left Click, Right Click).

selectOptions.label: Left button down
selectOptions.description: Presses the left mouse button down.

selectOptions.label: Right button down
selectOptions.description: Presses the right mouse button down.

fields.name: WaitBeforeSending
fields.label: Wait
fields.description: Milliseconds to wait before sending the mouse event.

fields.name: MoveMouse
fields.label: Move Mouse
fields.description: If true, moves the mouse to the current cursor position before sending the event.
